title: Profile ownership civil status spouse logic
summary: Implemented ownership-dependent profile form behavior where Civil Status is shown only for owners and Spouse is shown/saved only for married owners, with aligned database, API, model normalization, and view/PDF output updates.

items: Added migration to create/drop profiles.civil_status (VARCHAR(20) NULL)
Added civil status constants/options and normalizeCivilStatus()
Updated normalizeSpouseNameForSave() to require owner + married
Added civil_status in profile list/all selects and create/update SQL payloads
Added civil_status handling in profile payload gathering/building
Included civil_status in profile update change tracking fields
Updated API transformProfile() output with civil_status and married-only spouse exposure
Added Civil Status select row in profile form
Client logic now shows Civil Status only for owner
Client logic now shows Spouse only for owner + married, clearing hidden values on change
Profile view now renders Civil Status for owner records
Spouse row now renders only when owner civil status is married
PDF profile detail mirrors the same visibility rules
Updated ownership field test to assert Civil Status visibility and married-only spouse behavior
Updated create flow test to set civil_status=married before filling spouse
Documented new civil_status contract and owner/married spouse persistence rule
Recorded feature change summary and migration list update
